info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Architecture Insights API
info.description: The Enterprise Architecture Insights API provides access to strategic business direction data essential for informed decision-making in banking. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding enterprise architecture, helping organizations align their IT capabilities with business goals. Typical consumers include business analysts, architects, and decision-makers looking to assess and refine their architecture strategies. The API supports scenarios involving data-driven insights for optimizing enterprise architecture within the banking sector.

get.description: This operation retrieves the details of a specific Enterprise Architecture resource using its unique identifier. It provides valuable insights into the structure and components of the enterprise architecture.
